fusions.name: Trundled Cell
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away and closes a ring of bars there that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each one [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Treadmill Sentence
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it under [Cursed Step] for 5 seconds, so that every step it takes costs it health.

fusions.name: Locked Turnstile
fusions.desc: After a 0.3 second cast, every creature within 3 tiles is held in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pacing the Bars
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a ward that absorbs damage up to 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
